subject: Request: SLA exception & renewal incentive for Voltix
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jk@voltix.io>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: production issues and renewal

Rishi —

Thanks for the update on the incident. Voltix had two short windows of elevated latency last week that impacted our UI rendering (p95 moved from ~120ms to ~480ms during the incident window). Procurement is pushing our CFO to get tangible remediation before we sign the renewal. We need a clear ask: an SLA credit or another form of concession we can present to the exec committee.

Can Redwood offer an SLA accommodation (credit or a month free) and commit to a tighter latency SLO for the next 12 months? If you can get that in writing, I can push the renewal across the line.

Attaching the incident summary from our side.

—Jordan
Voltix, Head of Integrations
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: production issues and renewal — Voltix request

Team — forwarding Voltix's request. They want a concrete concession we can sign into the renewal: either a monetary credit or a free month and an SLO commitment for the next 12 months. Context: incident postmortem attached (see attachment: 20261113_voltix_incident_postmortem.pdf).

My read: this is an at-risk renewal (~$420k ARR, renewal in 30 days). Voltix is reasonable; they want an explicit remediation/guardrail. Proposed options to consider quickly:
- Option A (small): One-time credit of $45,000 + formal SLA document with a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment and p95 latency target <= 180ms for API endpoints used by Voltix, for 12 months.
- Option B (larger concession to close): One free month (prorated) + $25k credit + priority incident review for next 90 days + SLA doc with escalation path.

Ask: need executive approval for whichever option closes. Laura — any legal thorns with either? Marissa/Aditya — is $45k within sales approval or do we need exec sign-off? Evelyn — will CS own the remedial commitments?

If we can get a decision today I will draft the amendment and send to Voltix.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: production issues and renewal — Voltix request

Rishi —

Thanks for framing. Quick notes:
- Finance has a standard tolerance for credits up to $20k at my level; anything above that requires aditya/ops approval.
- We should avoid long-term SLA deviation language that binds infra without mitigation clauses. If we commit an aggressive p95 target, add objective exceptions tied to DDoS, network provider outages, and customer-induced load patterns.
- Legal will need a short-term amendment rather than rewriting the MSA.

I think Option A with a reduced credit to $35k plus a written SLA addendum with the noted exceptions would be approvable quickly. If you think Voltix requires more, loop in Aditya for exec sign-off.

Marissa
VP Sales Operations
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T12:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: production issues and renewal — Voltix request

Rishi/Marissa —

Legal ok with an amendment structured as: one-time credit amount to be inserted; one free month only if we select that route; SLA addendum with SLOs, exclusions, and a 60-day show-cause clause after any repeated violation. We should avoid language that creates a perpetual lowered bar.

I'll prepare a short amendment template; Rishi, please confirm final concession so I can populate.

Laura
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: production issues and renewal — Voltix request

Team — after reviewing the ARR and strategic fit, I approve Option A with the adjusted numbers: one-time credit of $40,000 and a written SLA addendum for 12 months. Conditions:

- SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime, p95 latency <= 175ms for the endpoints defined in the attachment; standard force majeure and network-provider exclusions apply.
- Credit: $40,000, applied as account credit over the next invoice cycle (Finance to action).
- The SLA addendum must include a 60-day remediation clause and a cap on cumulative credits at $80,000 for the contract term.
- CS (Evelyn) to own the post-incident monitoring dashboard and weekly syncs with Voltix for 60 days.

Rishi — you have executive approval. Laura/Marissa/Finance: please convert to an amendment and route through DocuSign. Evelyn: please set up the initial monitoring playbook and invite Voltix for a 1:1 next week.

Aditya
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jk@voltix.io>, Procurement <procure@voltix.io>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: production issues and renewal — Voltix request

Jordan —

Thanks for your patience. Executive approval granted: Redwood will provide a one-time credit of $40,000 and sign a 12-month SLA addendum that commits to 99.9% monthly uptime and a p95 latency target of <= 175ms for the specified API surface. The addendum includes standard exclusions (network provider outages, force majeure), a 60-day remediation clause, and a cumulative credit cap of $80,000.

Next steps:
- I will send a populated amendment (DocuSign link) by end of day; Laura is drafting the legal language.
- Finance will apply the credit to the renewal invoice once the amendment is executed.
- Evelyn will kick off the 60-day monitoring cadence — expect an invite for the first call next week.

Appreciate the partnership. Hoping this gets the renewal across the line.

Best,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
